title: Reported procurement locations have independent capability context without proving work-package assignment
source_unit: USAspending subaward rows compared with official company capability/quality documents for the reported locations
geography: Nashua, New Hampshire and Niceville, Florida, United States

observations.period: 2024-11-22; BAE subaward location and official capability context

denominator.unit: selected BAE subaward row and one official multi-site quality certificate

certificate_scope.value: design, production, and servicing of electronic components, subsystems, and systems for military and commercial products

work_package_assignment.unit: specific subaward work assigned to Nashua site

observations.method: Exact USAspending subaward/location record compared with the named site in BAE official quality certificate US014595; sources are matched by place but not pooled into a causal production claim.
observations.uncertainty: A certified quality scope establishes documented capability at the site, not performance of this award row, current line utilization, output, acceptance, delivery, or workforce.
observations.subgroup: BAE selected subaward row and 95 Canal Street Nashua site.
observations.counterinterpretation: The site may support the capability while another BAE facility or supplier performs the specific RF work.

observations.period: 2024-12-10; General Dynamics-OTS subaward location and official capability context

denominator.unit: selected General Dynamics-OTS subaward row and one official product/capability document

official_capability_context.value: Niceville Operations and advanced warhead technology/modeling and simulation material

work_package_assignment.unit: specific JASSM/LRASM case-assembly work assigned to Niceville site

observations.method: Exact USAspending subaward/location record compared with General Dynamics-OTS official product material naming Niceville Operations and 115 Hart Street; the product capability is retained as context, not as a work assignment.
observations.uncertainty: Company capability material does not establish that the selected case assembly was performed there, nor the quantity, acceptance, delivery, or current spare capacity.
observations.subgroup: General Dynamics-OTS selected subaward row and Niceville Operations.
observations.counterinterpretation: The document may describe organizational or product-line capability while the award work was performed at another OTS site or supplier.

observations.method: Cross-source place comparison preserving USAspending award fields, company capability documents, and the previous DLA identity route as separate source units.
observations.uncertainty: Two selected cases are not representative of the full supplier network; capability context cannot be promoted to production, readiness, delivery, replaceability, or leverage.
observations.subgroup: Two focal supplier routes in one bounded weapons-system procurement case.
observations.counterinterpretation: Capability context may be a necessary but insufficient condition for the specific award output; it may also coexist with shared parent dependencies or critical inputs.

related_sources.claim: The richer USAspending route establishes the exact subaward UEIs and reported locations.
DLA records establish a separate CAGE parent/facility hierarchy that is not automatically the reported USAspending location.
Secondary discovery source reports a candidate BAE Nashua CAGE/UEI pairing; not promoted as official DLA detail evidence.
Secondary discovery source reports a candidate General Dynamics-OTS Niceville CAGE/UEI pairing; not promoted as official DLA detail evidence.

boundary: Official capability and quality documents provide independent context for the reported locations. They do not prove that the specific JASSM/LRASM subaward was performed there, or that production, acceptance, delivery, replaceability, or geopolitical leverage followed.
